title: Entrance Fee Agreement Cancellation Fee for Current Larkspur Independent Living Renters
content:
A customer who already rents a Larkspur independent living apartment is treated as an internal move when cancelling an **Entrance Fee Agreement** before occupancy: where the customer holds an active independent living residency whose move-in date is 24 or more whole months before the cancellation, the fee after the trial-stay credit is halved and rounded down to the whole dollar; where that move-in date is 12 to 23 whole months before, the fee after the trial-stay credit is multiplied by 0.75 and rounded up to the whole dollar; otherwise the fee after the trial-stay credit stands to the cent.

## Records read

The customer's **Independent Living Residency Agreement** in active status and its move-in date. Whole months are counted from the move-in date to the day of the cancellation.

## Ladder

| Active independent living residency, whole months since move-in | Treatment of the fee | Rounding |
|---|---|---|
| 24 or more | Multiplied by 0.5 (halved) | Down to the whole dollar |
| 12 to 23 | Multiplied by 0.75 | Up to the whole dollar |
| Fewer than 12, or no active residency | Unchanged | Stands to the cent |

## Boundaries (hypothetical move-in 15 March 2023)

| Cancellation date | Whole months | Treatment |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2025 | 23 | 0.75, rounded up |
| 15 March 2025 | 24 | Halved, rounded down |
| 14 March 2024 | 11 | Unchanged |
| 15 March 2024 | 12 | 0.75, rounded up |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fee after the trial-stay credit of 6193.00)

- 24 or more months: 6193.00 halved is 3096.50, rounded down to 3096.00.
- 12 to 23 months: 6193.00 multiplied by 0.75 is 4644.75, rounded up to 4645.00.
- Otherwise: 6193.00.
